title: Verdict and Parish
author: O. M. Lockridge
blurb: Felix Kavanagh, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
